== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Rose]] Tower is a seven-story rectangular structure located on the eastern side of the Palace complex, situated against the wall that separates the [[Imperial]] Palace from the Capital. It is one of several identical towers positioned around the edges of the palace grounds. The building features smooth white plaster walls, tiered red roof tiles, and arrow-slits on various floors, with specific openings in the roof designed for marksmen. While a replica of this historic tower exists within the [[Consultants]]' Garden, the actual structure is used for significant events, such as negotiations. For these meetings, the top floor—which typically houses decorative plants, chairs, and a long table—is cleared to reveal a large square room with three painted circles on the floor to designate where participants stand. The tower's security is managed by both [[Imperial Guards]] and [[Luminian Knights]], who wear silver armor marked with the [[White Sun]]. The ground floor has hosted various groups, including members of the [[Independent Guilds]] alongside [[stone]] boxes etched with images of protective knights. During periods of conflict, the tower has been subject to tremors from battles and has served as a point of movement for various characters.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Rose]] Tower is a seven-story rectangular structure featuring white walls and serves as the location for an upcoming meeting. Situated at a base where [[Estyr Six]] stands, the tower is accessed through an archway and contains a large square room furnished with chairs and a long table. Before the gathering, the [[Consultants]] secured various exits around the perimeter of the building. During a battle between [[Estyr]] and two [[Guild Heads]], the top of the tower shook, after which [[Shera]] and [[Meia]] exited the premises.}}
